title: Recorded test value
responsibility: Presents recorded values as labelled fields, typed values, lists and result tables.

inputs.name: RecordedValue.value
inputs.description: The input, observed output or error exactly as read from verified evidence.

inputs.name: RecordedValue.fullValuesLabel
inputs.description: Name of the disclosure containing complete values; defaults to Full recorded values.

inputs.name: RecordedValue.rowsLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name for nested rows, distinguishing authored examples from recorded data.

outputs.name: RecordedValue
outputs.description: A readable, bounded preview. Full original data stays available in its recording.
